newsitem.title: UK: London investors to quiz Olivetti's Caio - report.
newsitem.headline: London investors to quiz Olivetti's Caio - report.

text.p: Leading institutional investors in Ing. C. Olivetti & C. SpA will press Chief Executive Francesco Caio for the appointment of an independent non-executive chairman, The London Independent said.

One large London-based investor said it would insist at a Monday meeting on a clear and transparent breakdown of Olivetti's exact financial position. Otherwise it would have to review its investment in the embattled company, it said.
One institutional investor quoted by the paper said: "It is all very well putting in new management, but the question is whether we are left with a company worth managing."
"People want to know what the real numbers are and what Olivetti's financial standing is," he added.
Caio is meeting clients after the group's announcement that it recorded a 440.2 billion lire loss for the first half of this year and that Chairman Carlo De Benedetti had resigned.
